include(ECMAddTests)

find_program(BASH_EXECUTABLE bash REQUIRED)
find_program(XORRISO_EXECUTABLE xorriso REQUIRED)
find_program(KIOCLIENT_EXECUTABLE kioclient REQUIRED)

# Fixtures are generated by the build, never committed: the smoke and dev-loop
# commands in AGENTS.md use build/tests/fixtures right after `cmake --build`.
set(KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/fixtures)
set(KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES
    ${KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES_DIR}/rr.iso
    ${KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES_DIR}/joliet.iso
)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES}
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES_DIR}
    COMMAND ${BASH_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures/make-fixtures.sh ${XORRISO_EXECUTABLE} ${KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES_DIR}
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures/make-fixtures.sh
    COMMENT "Generating ISO 9660 test fixtures with xorriso"
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_target(fixtures ALL DEPENDS ${KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES})

set(KIO_UNPACK_TEST_DEFINITIONS "KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES_DIR=\"${KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES_DIR}\"")

# Core unit tests: libkio-unpack-core without KIO.
ecm_add_tests(
    core/filebytesourcetest.cpp
    core/snifftest.cpp
    core/entrytabletest.cpp
    core/pathresolvertest.cpp
    backends/libarchivevolumetest.cpp
    NAME_PREFIX "unit-"
    LINK_LIBRARIES kio-unpack-core Qt6::Test
    COMPILE_DEFINITIONS ${KIO_UNPACK_TEST_DEFINITIONS}
    TARGET_NAMES_VAR KIO_UNPACK_UNIT_TARGETS
)

# Worker integration tests: the built plugin driven through KIO jobs.
# ecm_add_test puts build/bin on QT_PLUGIN_PATH (ADR 0009).
ecm_add_tests(
    worker/protocolinfotest.cpp
    worker/unpackworkertest.cpp
    NAME_PREFIX "integration-"
    LINK_LIBRARIES KF6::KIOCore Qt6::Test
    COMPILE_DEFINITIONS ${KIO_UNPACK_TEST_DEFINITIONS}
    TARGET_NAMES_VAR KIO_UNPACK_INTEGRATION_TARGETS
)

foreach(target IN LISTS KIO_UNPACK_UNIT_TARGETS KIO_UNPACK_INTEGRATION_TARGETS)
    add_dependencies(${target} fixtures)
endforeach()
foreach(target IN LISTS KIO_UNPACK_INTEGRATION_TARGETS)
    add_dependencies(${target} kio_unpack)
endforeach()

# Smoke tests: kioclient against the worker in the build tree, and
# kio-unpack-cli against the same fixtures (REQ-025, REQ-103).
add_test(NAME smoke-kioclient
    COMMAND ${BASH_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/smoke/smoke.sh
        ${KIOCLIENT_EXECUTABLE} $<TARGET_FILE:kio-unpack-cli> ${KIO_UNPACK_FIXTURES_DIR}
)
set_tests_properties(smoke-kioclient PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_PLUGIN_PATH=${CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}")

# REQ-087: no hardcoded installation prefix in code or build files.
add_test(NAME check-no-usr-paths
    COMMAND ${BASH_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/check-no-usr-paths.sh ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
)
